Title: Protect Azure VMs by using Storage Spaces Direct with Azure Site Recovery

Body.Content: Azure Site Recovery now supports disaster recovery of Azure virtual machines by using Storage Spaces Direct. You can use Site Recovery to make your higher-availability application more resilient with the addition of protection against region-level failure. For more information, see the documentation.
